answers.q1: Ruby with Bundler (Gemfile at the root, plus sinatra-contrib/Gemfile and rack-protection/Gemfile). Install with: bundle install. For the sub-gems, CI also runs: (cd sinatra-contrib && bundle install --jobs=3 --retry=3)
answers.q2: Core sinatra tests: bundle exec rake (default task is :test, Minitest). CI also runs the sub-gem suites: (cd sinatra-contrib && bundle exec rake) and (cd rack-protection && bundle exec rake). Full command: bundle exec rake && (cd sinatra-contrib && bundle exec rake) && (cd rack-protection && bundle exec rake)
answers.q3: cd sinatra-contrib && bundle exec rspec spec/capture_spec.rb
answers.q4: CI does not run any lint or formatting step. .github/workflows/test.yml only runs tests, and the Rakefile and CONTRIBUTING.md have no rubocop task. RuboCop (~> 1.32.0) is in the Gemfile and configured in .rubocop.yml, so the local check is: bundle exec rubocop. The config excludes test/, rack-protection/ and sinatra-contrib/.
answers.q5: No vendored or checked-in generated sources. .gitignore lists these generated or ignored paths, which should not be edited or committed: *.lock (Gemfile.lock), /pkg, /coverage, /doc (yard/rdoc output, including doc/api), .yardoc, .bundle, vendor/ (e.g. vendor/bundle), and *.gem. Within the repo, sinatra-contrib/doc/ is also generated by the doc:readmes and doc:index rake tasks.
